poin.isi: Two surveys by research institute Epoch AI and polling firm Ipsos found near-daily AI use among US adults doubled in six months: from 8% in March to 19% in August. Occasional users — those using AI only one day a week — fell from 17% to 10%.

AI is shifting from experiment to everyday habit, used routinely for work and personal tasks. One honest caveat: the two surveys asked different questions, so the August figure may actually understate real usage.
The question is no longer whether to use AI, but how well you use it. Start with one workflow, measure the outcome, then expand.

headline: AI IS NO LONGER A TRIAL RUN,
IT IS A DAILY HABIT
headline_caption: Epoch AI and Ipsos: near-daily AI use among US adults doubled in six months, from 8% to 19%
subjudul: Near-daily AI use doubled in six months — from 8% to 19%.
